question: Seven boxes F, G, H, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.Only three boxes are kept below H. Only two boxes are kept between H and O. Only N is kept above G. F is kept at some place below M and at some place above P. Which box is kept at second position from the bottom?
solution:
Given: Seven boxes F, G, H, M, N, O and P are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order

 
• Only three boxes are kept below H.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between H and O.
 
• Only N is kept above G.
 
• F is kept at some place below M and at some place above P.
